1. Who can use AstroBro

  • You must be 18 years or older and able to enter into a contract under Indian law.
  • AstroBro is not meant for children. Do not create an account if you are under 18. If we learn that an account belongs to someone under 18, we will close it and delete its data.
  • Give accurate information and keep it up to date.
  • Use one account for yourself only. You are responsible for what is done through your account and for keeping your password secret. Tell us straight away at [support_email not set] if you think someone else has used it.

2. What the Service offers

  • Calculations: Kundli, Panchang, Dasha, transits, doshas, matching, numerology, muhurat, festival dates and similar tools, calculated from the birth details you enter using standard Vedic methods (Lahiri ayanamsa). Wrong birth details give wrong results.
  • AI Jyotish: answers written by an artificial intelligence (AI) model using your chart and reference texts. AI answers are produced by a machine, are marked as AI answers, and can be wrong.
  • Consultations: paid chat, voice and video sessions with independent astrologers (section 6).
  • Puja and pandit bookings (section 7).
  • Paid features: premium plans, detailed PDF reports and the AstroBro wallet (section 5).
  • Articles, mantras and remedies: general information drawn from traditional and public-domain texts.
  • Tarot, love calculator and similar games: for entertainment only.

3. Astrology is guidance, not a guarantee

Astrology is a traditional belief system. Readings, AI answers and astrologers' views are offered for personal reflection and entertainment. They are not scientifically proven predictions, and we do not promise any result. Nothing in the Service is medical, mental-health, legal, financial, investment, tax or other professional advice. Please read the Astrology & AI Disclaimer.

If you are in distress or thinking about harming yourself, call Tele-MANAS on 14416 (free, 24×7) or the emergency number 112. AstroBro cannot help in an emergency.

4. Your content

  • "Your content" means the questions, messages, birth details, reviews and other material you add to the Service. You keep ownership of it.
  • You allow us to store, process, display and transmit your content only as needed to run, secure and improve the Service, as explained in the Privacy Policy. This permission ends when your content is deleted, except where the law requires us to keep it.

5. Prices, payments, plans, reports and the wallet

  • Prices are in Indian rupees and are shown before you pay. They include applicable taxes unless the app says otherwise. There are no hidden charges.
  • Payments are processed by Razorpay. Your card, UPI and bank details are entered with Razorpay and never reach us. Razorpay sends you a confirmation of each payment; ask us at [support_email not set] if you need a receipt.
  • We never pre-tick a purchase for you. A payment happens only when you confirm it in the Razorpay sheet.
  • Premium plans are one-time payments for a fixed period (7, 30, 90 or 365 days). They do not renew automatically, so there is nothing to cancel. A plan gives a much higher daily AI chat allowance (a fair-use limit, currently 300 a day), removes ads and includes the detailed PDF report. Without a plan you get a limited number of free AI chats each day (currently 10) and may see ads.
  • A detailed PDF report is a one-time purchase for one report.
  • The AstroBro wallet is a prepaid balance used only to pay for consultations and bookings on AstroBro.
    • You can add between ₹100 and ₹5,000 at a time.
    • The balance can be used only for services on AstroBro. It cannot be transferred to anyone else, withdrawn as cash or used anywhere else, and it does not earn interest.
    • Refunds for consultations and bookings go back to your wallet unless the Refund Policy says otherwise.
    • You can ask for unused balance to be refunded, as described in the Refund & Cancellation Policy.
    • If a wallet entry is made by mistake (for example a duplicate credit), we may correct it, and the correction will appear in your wallet history.
  • We may change prices for future purchases. A price change never affects something you have already paid for.

6. Consultations with astrologers

  • Astrologers on AstroBro are independent practitioners, not our employees. We review each application before approving a profile, but we cannot guarantee any astrologer's skill or accuracy, and their views are their own.
  • AstroBro arranges and bills each consultation. You pay AstroBro, and AstroBro pays the astrologer their share after keeping a platform fee.
  • Billing: the per-minute rate is shown before you send a request. The first minute is charged when the astrologer accepts, and each further minute is charged as it starts. You need enough balance for at least 5 minutes to start. A session ends when either of you ends it, when your balance cannot pay for the next minute, after 10 minutes with no messages, or after 3 hours.
  • A request nobody accepts expires after about 2 minutes and costs nothing. A chat the astrologer accepted but never answered is refunded to your wallet in full.
  • Calls and video take place in a private Jitsi Meet room created for your session. Anyone who has the room link can join, so do not share it. We do not record calls or video. Chat messages are stored as explained in the Privacy Policy.
  • Keep it on AstroBro. Do not share phone numbers, email addresses, social media handles or links, and do not pay an astrologer outside AstroBro. Messages that contain contact details are blocked. We cannot protect payments made outside the app.
  • Astrologers must not promise results, claim to cure illness, offer "black magic", vashikaran or similar services, ask for money outside the app, or frighten you into buying remedies. If an astrologer does any of this, use the Report option after the session or write to [grievance_email not set]. We investigate every report.
  • Reviews must be honest and based on your own consultation. Do not post fake reviews or reviews in exchange for a reward. We do not edit reviews, but we remove reviews that break these Terms. Ratings shown are the average of genuine reviews.

7. Puja and pandit bookings

  • You choose a service from the catalogue, a date, a place and contact details, and pay through Razorpay. We then confirm the booking and arrange a pandit.
  • You can cancel in the app before we confirm the booking and get a full refund to your wallet. After confirmation, the Refund & Cancellation Policy applies.
  • The address and phone number you give are shared only with the pandit who performs the service. Please give accurate details and treat the pandit with respect. A pandit may decline to proceed if the place is unsafe.
  • Rituals are a matter of faith. We do not promise any outcome.
